reviewed_candidate: MiniMart Architecture Refinement v0.3 Freeze Candidate

findings.title: One-counter co-location and multi-counter host placement are no longer stated explicitly
findings.evidence: Frozen NFR-DEP-002/003 requires one-counter deployment to allow POS + Store Node + PostgreSQL on the same Windows PC and multi-counter deployment to use counters over LAN to the designated Store Node/database host. v0.1 stated this explicitly; v0.3 remains compatible but no longer states it.
findings.impact: No architecture contradiction, but a deployment/coding agent could miss a required supported placement.
findings.correction: Restore explicit placement wording in Architecture v1.0: one-counter may colocate POS, Store Node and PostgreSQL on one Windows PC; multi-counter uses one designated Store Node/database host; placement does not change domain behavior.

findings.title: AI-assisted development and release-quality guardrails are only partially explicit
findings.evidence: v0.3 preserves ADR triggers, migration checks and protected-test checks, but does not explicitly carry forward frozen NFR-TEST-002 or the approved reference guardrails for spec+acceptance before agent coding and contract/sync-simulation/ledger CI gates.
findings.impact: No business/domain/database semantic change, but the architecture package is less complete as the coding-agent handbook.
findings.correction: Add implementation governance: spec/acceptance first; AI agents may not weaken tests; production migrations are human-reviewed; material architecture changes require ADR; CI gates protected domain/ledger, contract and sync-simulation tests.

findings.title: Phase-0 carry-forward wording is slightly incomplete
findings.evidence: v0.3 includes packaging, hardware, multilingual raster-receipt and real sync proof spikes, but the approved Reference Architecture Phase-0 plan also names sync-engine evaluation and specifically Malayalam/Malay receipt testing.
findings.impact: The current spikes are compatible and partly stronger, but approved Phase-0 traceability is not exact.
findings.correction: State that the sync spike records sync-engine evaluation/decision evidence and that the target-printer raster test includes Malayalam and Malay when those scripts are in the pilot scope.
